additional_info.subject: ID0436682-DC/Si-D/DK-[MP / R3 170001653] DC_Contactor_DC1_QA21-22 error CRM:02919000150
additional_info.body:
Hi Rasmus, good morning.
Please proceed with the replacement of QA21-22:
As you can see, there is a WLD: 1 which means:
WLD: true = welded has been detected (this state would be latched until WDA=true, WIR=false and detection is no longer enabled or until charger reboot), false = welding is no longer detected or not occurred yet
So it's clear that we need to replace it since a reboot didn't fix it.
I will send this ticket back to you.
Best regards,
Francisco
